description: Block vulnerability scanners: dotfiles, server scripts, config dumps and WordPress paths the app never serves
expression: (http.request.uri.path contains "/." and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/.well-known/")) or lower(http.request.uri.path) contains "%2f." or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".php") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".asp") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".aspx") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".jsp") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".cgi") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".sql") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".bak") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".yml") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".yaml") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp/") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wordpress") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/cgi-bin") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/phpmyadmin") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/bitrix/") or lower(http.request.uri.path) contains "/wp-admin/" or lower(http.request.uri.path) contains "/wp-content/" or lower(http.request.uri.path) contains "/wp-includes/"
